partners.mechanism_chain: FAM20C (HGNC:24702) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix mineralization (GO:0001507); Extracellular matrix mineralization (GO:0001507) —LEADS_TO→ Osteosclerosis (HP:0004475); APOA1 (HGNC:534) —DISRUPTS→ Lipid transport and metabolism (GO:0006629); Lipid transport and metabolism (GO:0006629) —LEADS_TO→ Amyloid fibril formation (GO:0045914); Amyloid fibril formation (GO:0045914) —LEADS_TO→ Systemic amyloidosis (HP:0003257). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in APOA1 disrupt lipid transport and metabolism, promoting amyloid fibril formation and systemic amyloidosis.
